const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const { runHook } = require('./hooks');
async function extract(archivePath, destination) {
  const archive = await openZip(archivePath);

    const output = path.join(destination, entry.name);

- The safe variant `runApproved()` in `process/safe-hook.js` (fixed binary, `shell:false`, name allowlist) is never wired into the flow.
